name: Daiquiri
description: White rum, lime, and sugar in bright balance—the sour that teaches everything else.
history: Named for Daiquirí, Cuba, and popularized in the early 20th century. At its best it is shaken hard, strained cold, and never drowned in mix.
whyItWorks: Lime acidity and sugar frame rum’s cane sweetness. The drink lives or dies on fresh juice and proper dilution.
steps: Add rum, lime juice, and simple syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled, about 12–15 seconds.
Garnish with a lime wheel if desired.
techniqueNotes: Taste and adjust: more syrup if sharp, more lime if flat.
Havana Club 3 Años sits near the classic light-rum profile; Especial reads richer.

variations.name: Coconut Daiquiri
